sources.title: Apple FY2025 Form 10-K
sources.excerpt: Fiscal year ended September 27, 2025; consolidated statements in millions USD, shares in thousands, per-share amounts unscaled. FY2025/FY2024/FY2023: total net sales 416,161/391,035/383,285; net income 112,010/93,736/96,995; diluted EPS 7.46/6.08/6.13; operating income 133,050/123,216/114,301; cash generated by operating activities 111,482/118,254/110,543; payments for acquisition of property plant and equipment (12,715)/(9,447)/(10,959). FY2025 SBC 12,863; R&D 34,550; cash-flow repurchases (90,711), equity-award settlement taxes (5,960), dividends (15,421). Capital Return discussion: repurchased $89.3 billion common stock, $100 billion program announced May 2025. Repurchase accounting/cash timing differs. FY2025 product gross margin 36.8%, Services 75.4%, total 46.9%; FY2024 37.2%/73.9%/46.2%; FY2023 36.5%/70.8%/44.1%. FY2025 categories: iPhone 209,586, Mac 33,708, iPad 28,023, Wearables Home Accessories 35,686, Services 109,158. Geographic net sales: Americas 178,353, Europe 111,032, Greater China 64,377, Japan 28,703, Rest of Asia Pacific 33,696. Greater China FY2024 66,952, FY2023 72,559; decline primarily lower iPhone. Effective tax rate 2025 15.6%, 2024 24.1%; $10.7 billion year-over-year decrease in State Aid-related provision. FY2025 cash equivalents 35,934, current securities 18,763, noncurrent securities 77,723. Majority manufacturing outsourced primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam; certain custom components single/limited-source. Services includes advertising, licensing, AppleCare, cloud, content and payment services; third-party App Store sales recognized as net commission. US court order prevents commissions or fees on certain external purchases; DMA alternative distribution/payment requirements; Google search licensing subject to litigation. Direct/indirect channels 40%/60%. Fiscal year last Saturday of September.

sources.title: European Commission DMA noncompliance decision
sources.excerpt: April23 2025: Commission found Apple breached DMA anti-steering obligation and fined Apple€500 million. Developers should inform users free of charge of alternative offers and allow purchases. Apple ordered to remove technical/commercial steering restrictions and refrain from equivalent conduct. Compliance required within60 days or periodic penalties. This is the historical decision, not a claim that current2026 remedy/appeal outcomes were fully researched. Foreign-currency penalty not converted into USD fact.

sources.excerpt: July14 2026 preliminary IDC Quarterly Mobile Phone Tracker: China smartphone shipments about66 million units, down4.3%, fifth consecutive decline. IDC says Huawei/Apple held prices steady with targeted promotions; Apple purchases pulled forward ahead of expected second-half price rises.
